Title: Help Desk Analyst I
Company: Northstar Health Systems
Location: Remote - United States
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: $24 - $28 / hour

About the role
Northstar Health Systems provides software and support services to regional clinics across the United States.

Responsibilities
- Provide level 1 help desk support for end users across Windows, Mac, Outlook, and browser-based tools.
- Troubleshoot hardware, software, password reset, VPN, and remote access issues.
- Document tickets clearly in the ticketing system and maintain knowledge base articles.
- Communicate with users by phone, email, and chat.

Requirements
- Strong troubleshooting and documentation habits.
- Comfort learning new tools quickly.
- Entry-level candidates are welcome.
- Experience with Jira, Freshdesk, Office 365, or similar systems is helpful.

Benefits
- Medical, dental, PTO
- Clear training plan and team support
